decisions.reason: As a peripheral consumer product with only a brief website mention and no flagship commitment, the firm has little invested or public justification to maintain it, making discontinuation likely under escalation-of-commitment logic.
This modular waste-to-energy extension line involves substantial engineering investment and multiple models close to the established core, so escalation pressures favor persistence.
Its own webpage and flagship status signal high public commitment and centrality, making a write-off of sunk costs and exposure of failure highly unattractive.
As a flagship focus close to the established offer, it carries substantial investment and visible commitment, so the firm is likely to persist.
